reason: An injected failure at the first xmlXIncludeNewRef allocation sets the harness failure flag. The changed memory reporter does not set the XInclude context’s errNo, so the existing check expects false and aborts. The removed reporter did set errNo for this same failure.
finite_witness: Frame a main entity with URL main.xml and document <r xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2003/XInclude"><xi:include href="other.xml"/></r>. Set the four-byte allocation selector to the finite index of xmlXIncludeNewRef’s first xmlMalloc after the harness enables injection. Add an unused framed entity with enough bytes that size + 100 exceeds that index.

scope_contract.reason: The old entry invokes xmlXIncludeProcessNode and checks its XInclude context error after processing; reference creation and its memory error reporting are inside that operation.

evidence.dependency_reason: Include expansion calls the reference creator.

feasible_trigger.reason: The framed input can provide a valid include and select its reference allocation as the injected failure. Padding an unused entity can make the input-size modulus admit that finite allocation index.

evidence.dependency_reason: The input format permits framed strings.
The first entity supplies the main document; additional entities can increase input size.
The selected allocation returns NULL and records failure.

observable_consequence.reason: The replacement reporter writes the global error but leaves the zero-initialized XInclude context error unchanged. The getter therefore supplies a false expectation while the allocation-failure flag is true, and the existing check aborts.

evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated reporter has no XInclude context error argument.
Context allocation initializes errNo to zero.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: A valid document gives a nonnull context. Failure at the first reference allocation returns before resource loading or fallback can report another error; the complete old entry has no other XInclude error check before this assertion.

evidence.dependency_reason: Reference creation failure returns from AddNode.
Expansion returns before LoadNode on this failure.
A nonnull parsed document permits a context.

identity_preserved.reason: Both sides assess the same failure at xmlXIncludeNewRef’s first allocation and the same old-harness error check. The removed reporter set ctxt->errNo; the added reporter does not. The g0007 change concerns another reference allocation failure and does not replace this tuple.

evidence.dependency_reason: Identifies the exact allocation and failure path on the after side.
The g0007 removed call is for reference-table growth, a separate allocation site.
The g0007 added call is likewise for reference-table growth.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows where the delegated memory reporter stores the error.
Shows which error state the harness reads.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The input frames the main document and optional extra entities.
